notes.title: Final Update!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all [b]6200~ steam users[/b] who've given our game a go. It has been a pleasure to receive your encouraging comments and reviews. Here's what I've cooked up for ya

[h3]Thank you to the fans and superfans![/h3]
This update is the final update to Pixel Fixel, with the exception of any possible bug fixes as steam or operating systems change. Pixel Fixel has been on Steam for just over a year. It brought me great pleasure and fulfillment seeing everyone play it and enjoy it.

I want to additionally thank everyone who stopped by the [url=https://discord.gg/GtcKH3V6GZ]Discord[/url] and participated in the Tournaments. The tournaments will no longer be regularly scheduled, but we might do impromptu ones in the [url=https://discord.gg/GtcKH3V6GZ]Discord[/url]. The tournament winners deserve a special mention. Congrats and thank you to: Ohni, Fluffybaby, Roborino, and Delphic.

Also, thank you to (currently) 105 positive reviews on Steam. I've read all of them and love the support you all have shown! 

I look forward to further game releases, and hopefully I will end up making more stuff you all can enjoy!

[h3]Changes in this update[/h3][list]
[*]Added a transition between scenes and different menus. The color of the transition will depend on the colorway you have selected or the level you're playing.
[*] An option was added to reduce the opacity of the squares that appear on Hint and Static blocks.
[*]Small bug fixes with the screenshot flash, 
[/list]

notes.title: DLC Update!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all [b]5600~ steam users[/b] who've given our game a go. It has been a pleasure to receive your encouraging comments and reviews. Here's what I've cooked up for ya!

[h3]Gradient Gap[/h3]
The Remixel DLC has been a big hit! So I decided to add even more content for the owners of it. Introducing a new game mode called Gradient Gap. In this game mode you will progressively get harder and harder levels where you need to place a single block in the correction position. Who knows how far someone will go, so far my best has been Round 22.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44878907/337f45a1c71162bd5d0fbf272519c6430f304c54.png[/img]


[h3]Tournament Still Holding Strong![/h3]
We are running another Pixel Fixel tournament in our discord. A corresponding page with details has been is in the game. Essentially, players will compete in a 1v1 single-elimination tournament to win prizes. [url=https://discord.gg/GtcKH3V6GZ]Join us in our discord to participate[/url], we're having our 6th season of the tournament on November 24th! Looking forward to seeing y'all there.

[h3]And more![/h3][list]
[*]Added 1 new theme to the Remixel DLC, "Darkness."
[*]Added lots of people to the credits, thank you so much for all the support!
[*]Lots of work preparing the game for an iOS and Android launch. It already exists on the Google Play store if you're interested :)
[/list]

notes.title: August 2024 - Small Update
notes.notes:
Thank you to all [b]5000~ steam users[/b] who've given our game a go. It has been a pleasure to receive your encouraging comments and reviews. This time we have a small patch with some tweaks. The next one will be a little bit bigger because we're aiming to do an iOS and Android launch!

[h3]Changes and Additions[/h3][list]
[*] Added new theme for Remixel owners! 
[*] Fixed the level completion counts for the messages on title screen
[*] When a player uses a hint in multiplayer, it alerts both players

As always, thanks for checking out the game, and being interested in the updates! We have lots of stuff going on with Pixel Fixel and other games [url=https://discord.gg/GtcKH3V6GZ]in our discord. [/url]

If you're ever looking for someone to play with or updates on the tournament, head over [url=https://discord.gg/GtcKH3V6GZ]to our discord![/url]

notes.title: May 2024 - New Colors Update!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all [b]2200~ steam users[/b] who've given our game a go. It has been a pleasure to receive your encouraging comments and reviews. An even bigger patch than the one from last month!

[h3]New Colors[/h3]
It has been pointed out that the way we generate the colors for each puzzle is not ideal. Long story short: we've been using raw RGB values interpolated between the corner blocks. This creates a slightly muddy color for the middle blocks in a lot of cases, wherein the color isn't what you would expect. 

To adjust for this, we've rewritten the color generation system to go into OKLAB colorspace, form a gradient, and then back to RGB. This gives the colors a more 'realistic' appearance. Here's an image that demonstrates a before and after this change. In a lot of cases, the change will be very subtle, in some cases, it will be more pronounced. Hopefully, this helps people judge which colors go where more easily :)

[img]https://i.ibb.co/r4xwcTV/125915883.png[/img]

[h3]Tournament[/h3]
We've teamed up with Lospec to run a Pixel Fixel tournament in our discord. There is a corresponding page added to the game that has details. Essentially, players will compete in a 1v1 single-elimination tournament to win prizes. [url=https://discord.gg/GtcKH3V6GZ]Join us in our discord to participate[/url], the first tournament will be on [b]May 18th 7:00 pm US-EST.[/b]

[h3]And more![/h3][list]
[*] Fixed Level 25's name. It had a duplicate name with a different level.
[*] Added a new way to scroll through levels, 5 pages at a time!
[*] Added a "wave" function to the collection screen, why the heck not!
[*] Levels start in a more aesthetically pleasing way, with the blocks appearing and growing.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a screen transition to take way longer than normal.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused level metadata to not update when going back to the level select screen.
[*] Added more users to the credits, thanks so much for your help, everyone!
[*] Fixed a bug that caused lag when viewing the collection screen for some low-end devices.
[*] More visual stuff for the options menu.
[/list]

notes.title: April 2024 - Daily Puzzle Update!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all [b]1800~ steam users[/b] who've given our game a go. It has been a pleasure to receive your encouraging comments and reviews. Here is our biggest patch yet! Here is a list of all the features we've introduced. The aim is to do another major patch sometime in the future, but for now we will collect more feedback and ideas.

[h3]Daily Puzzles[/h3]
This is a pretty big feature and may have a few hiccups. Essentially, each day it will generate a unique puzzle combination. This should be the same for everyone in the world. Players will be tasked with completing it before they run out of moves. Give it a try!

[h3]Tournament[/h3]
We've teamed up with Lospec to run a Pixel Fixel tournament in our discord. There is a corresponding page added in the game that has details. Essentially, players will compete in a 1v1 single-elimination tournament to win prizes. Join us in our discord to participate, the first tournament will be May 18th 7:00pm US-EST.

[h3]Steam Cloud[/h3]
Upon closing the game, the cloud save will be updated. This allows your progress to carry over any machine using the same steam account!

[h3]More Options[/h3]
We have added two new Soundscapes! "Harp" & "Stormy" and one new theme "Paper." In the future we'll add some more!

[h3]And more![/h3][list]
[*] We have a new logo! You'll see this new logo all throughout steam.
[*] Added Tutorial to the main menu
[*] A credits page! A small token of our appreciation for everyone who has left a positive steam review!
[*] Toggling the "Confetti" option gives you a taste of the party to come
[*] Added lots of decorative elements to all aspects of the game
[*] More secret codes! There are even more secret codes to unlock via the Sacred Gradient (Collection). Additionally, typing in a secret code now reverses its effects.
[*] Fixed issue with the pickup and drop sound effects clipping
[*] 5 new achievements
[*] Changed completion requirement for unlocking a new level-select page. It now takes 94 completed levels to unlock the final page, down from 141.
[/list]

notes.title: March 04/24 Tiny Update!
notes.notes:
Hey! Just wanted to say thanks for all the feedback and reviews we've been getting so far, its very exciting! Here are some small changes I made, more are coming soon!

[list]
[*] Made sure closing menu won't click on a block
[*] Added secrets, you'll find them in the Collection screen. The sacred gradient will guide you, if you're worthy!
[*] Changed the display for the sacred gradient to emphasize Pro Mode completions moreso!
[*] Added an option to disable confetti, it's disabled by default
[*] Game now stores your fullscreen setting so you don't have to re-enable it when you re-launch
[*] Cleaned up some things that should ensure better performance on low-end machines
[/list]
